name: akeeba/s3
description: A compact, dependency-less Amazon S3 API client implementing the most commonly used features

minio:up: docker compose -f IntegrationTest/docker/compose.yml --profile init run --rm create-bucket

scripts-descriptions.test: Run the unit tests, then the integration tests against every environment in .env.test (if any)
scripts-descriptions.test:unit: Run the unit tests. No network, no S3 account
scripts-descriptions.test:integration: Run the integration suite against each environment in .env.test. Options: --env=A,B --quick --list -- <phpunit args>
scripts-descriptions.test:minio: Start MinIO in Docker, run the integration suite against it, stop it
scripts-descriptions.minio:up: Start the MinIO container with the test bucket
scripts-descriptions.minio:down: Stop the MinIO container and delete its data
